title: Southern Vanguard 27   Sources Sought Colombia
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.410TH CSB.0410 AQ HQ     CONTRACT
description_text: This is an RFI/Sources Sought notice for Southern Vanguard 27, scheduled for execution in November 2026. A Vendor Day will be held in June in Colombia (location TBD). Estimated personnel support requirement is 500. The list below are the potential requriements: Catered Meals Bottled Water Ice bagged Refer Van A/C Trailer lights set Generators Shower Trailers Trash Collection/Removal Chemical Latrines/HW Laundry Services General Labor Lease Vehicles w/Driver (SUVs, Vans) Forklift Line Haul 44-50 Pax buses along with box trucks Deployment/Redeploymen Please include a capabilities statement in the email, written in English. The email subject line: Southern Vanguard 27 Capabilities Point of Contracts: Primary: SSG Juan Caburian email: juan.p.caburian2.mil@army.mil Secondary: SFC Aaron Thompson email: aaron.c.thompson26.mil@army.mil
